# Router trace catalog

This catalog covers the custom `llm_d.*` attributes defined by the `semconv`
package and four EPP scheduling spans.
Attribute names and Go helper signatures are compatibility contracts.
The registry's development stability describes llm-d conventions, not upstream OTel standardization.

The EPP spans also attach `gen_ai.request.model` and `gen_ai.request.id` when
available, except `run_scheduler_profile`, which only attaches the profile name.
Those shared helpers are defined in
[`genai.go`](../pkg/common/observability/semconv/genai.go).
Span attributes are described for recorded spans. Interrupted operations may end
before their completion attributes are set.

To change this catalog or its Go definitions, edit
[`registry/`](../pkg/common/observability/semconv/registry/) and run
`make update-telemetry`. `make verify-telemetry-docs` validates the registry and
compares regenerated files without modifying the working tree. It is included
in `make presubmit`. `make test-telemetry` exercises stale-file detection.

Generation uses Weaver, pinned with release checksums in
[`hack/weaver.sh`](../hack/weaver.sh). The first run downloads the binary;
subsequent runs use the platform-specific cache under `bin/`.
Prometheus metrics are documented separately in [metrics.md](metrics.md).

## EPP spans

### `filter_endpoints`

Applies the filter chain to candidate endpoints. Kind: `internal`.

| Attribute | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `llm_d.epp.filter.candidate_endpoints` | required |
| `llm_d.epp.filter.filtered_endpoints` | When the filter chain returns normally. |

### `pick_endpoints`

Selects an endpoint from the scored candidates. Kind: `internal`.

| Attribute | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `llm_d.epp.picker.candidate_endpoints` | required |
| `llm_d.epp.picker.top_endpoints` | When at least one scored endpoint is available. |
| `llm_d.epp.picker.top_scores` | When at least one scored endpoint is available. |

### `run_scheduler_profile`

Runs one named scheduler profile. Kind: `internal`.

| Attribute | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `llm_d.epp.scheduling.profile.name` | required |

### `scoring`

Combines weighted scores from the configured scorers. Kind: `internal`.

| Attribute | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| `llm_d.epp.scorer.count` | required |
| `llm_d.epp.scoring.candidate_endpoints` | required |
